note: The product's own assistant. Its brain file is the one that is not thin (10 902 B), so the bucket carries one thin case and leans on jargon and plan-repetition instead (design-benchmark §1.1).

say: w ken el client yekteb bel frança?
cases.why: The plan block, then a second question. Tests that the second answer does NOT repeat the three plans (R14), and that «it answers in French too» is said in everyday words — no jargon (R23, 09 §6).
@vs-chatgpt exists in full, three lines. The two failures it hunts: reaching for jargon on a technical question (R23), and turning three approved lines into six messages.

say: Ken n7eb nwa99ef ba3d chhar, kifech na3mel?
cases.why: Nothing in brain/digiplus.md covers stopping the subscription: no notice, no engagement, no refund. The assistant sells a monthly price it cannot say how to leave, so this is where it invents a term of sale.
One word, no question mark. @price is two messages and covers it exactly. The failure to watch for is @which-activity fired first at someone who asked a price.

say: ch7al taman dyal l'assistant? bghit n3ref
cases.why: Moroccan client on our own assistant (09 §1: ch7al, dyal, bghit). derja.js SWAP rewrites all three at send time, so the only place this can be seen is the raw model output — the answer must be 9adech / mte3 / n7eb and never echo the client.
